title: IntentGate audit event
description: One event of schema intentgate.audit/1: `audit.json` in the out dir of `intentgate verify`, and one line of <state>/audit.jsonl for every local `verify`, `lock` and `amend`. It holds ids, hashes and counts only: no code, diff, criterion text, footprint or root intent text. Every key is always present; a value that does not apply to the event kind is an empty string, or 0 for pr and exit_code, and a lock without a review duration has null.

repo.description: owner/name from --repo (verify) or the origin remote (lock, amend); empty when unknown.

pr.description: The pull request number from --pr; 0 when not given or not a verify event.

base_sha.description: verify only: the full commit the base revision resolved to.

head_sha.description: verify only: the full commit the head revision resolved to.

config_sha256.description: verify only: hex SHA-256 of .intentgate.yml at head (of nothing when the file is absent).

verify_sha256.description: verify only: hex SHA-256 of the bytes of the run's verify.json. `verify --replay` compares a fresh run against it.

locks.description: verify: the lock files at head that parse. lock, amend: the one lock written. Sorted by id.

outcome.description: verify: the outcome of verify.json. lock, amend: written.

conclusion.description: verify: the check run's conclusion. lock, amend: empty.
